mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate indicates monetary easing, which stimulates economic activity and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 returns are not positively correlated with FEDFUNDS declines over a 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth reflects strong economic demand, leading to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If GDP growth does not correlate with positive S&P 500 returns.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment rates indicate a strong labor market, boosting consumer spending and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If low unemployment does not lead to positive S&P 500 returns.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth signals increased economic output, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If industrial production growth does not correlate with positive S&P 500 returns.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts indicate increased construction activity, signaling economic expansion and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases by 5% in the last quarter
failure_condition: If housing starts growth does not lead to positive S&P 500 returns.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP growth accelerates and unemployment decreases simultaneously, it signals strong economic health, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If GDP growth and unemployment improvements do not correlate with positive S&P 500 returns.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in federal funds rate indicates monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS increases do not lead to negative S&P 500 returns.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, strong retail sales and low unemployment signal sustained economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If retail sales growth and low unemployment do not correlate with positive S&P 500 returns.
